title: Hello, Friend!
text: Hello! My name is Amy. I have a new friend. Her name is Lily. Every morning, we say good morning to our teacher. Before lunch, we say good afternoon. In the evening, we say good evening too. If I need help, I say excuse me, can you help me, please. Lily always helps me. At the end of the day, we say good night and bye. Thank you for reading my story!

questions.question: What does Amy say to greet everyone?
What does Amy say in the evening?
questions.source_sentence: In the evening, we say good evening too.

questions.question: What does Amy say at the end of the day?
questions.source_sentence: At the end of the day, we say good night and bye.
